extract_post_relax_config: extract post-relaxation filtering parameters like energy cutoff and density tolerance from a workflow config dictionary
filter_single_dataset: filter and deduplicate crystal structures in a single parquet dataset by energy density and connectivity
filter_multiple_datasets: orchestrate parallel SLURM jobs to filter and deduplicate multiple crystal structure datasets across directories
validate_connectivity: validate that covalent bonding connectivity is preserved between unrelaxed and relaxed crystal structures
deduplicate_structures: deduplicate similar crystal structures using pymatgen StructureMatcher with configurable lattice site and angle tolerances
